messages:
Yara Bloom: Quick sync: proposing a 'risk-lane' taxonomy for catalog onboards so PMs/ops can choose a migration posture per model. Idea: Low-risk (auto-swap), Medium-risk (soft-pin 14d), High-risk (manual canary + exemption). We need concrete gating rules and deprecation exit paths.

Victor Chen: Love the taxonomy. Can you enumerate the gating rules per lane? e.g., quality delta, latency bounds, embed-compat. Also how does this affect pin lifecycles and migration credits?

Yara Bloom: Draft lanes + gates: 
- Low-risk: quality_delta <= 0.5pp, p95 <= baseline+15%, cost_delta <= +5%, embed_compat=true -> eligible for auto-swap after 3d canary.
- Medium-risk: quality_delta <= 1.5pp, p95 <= baseline+30%, cost_delta <= +12% -> soft-pin 14d required for paid tenants, 3d for self-serve.
- High-risk: any slice >1.5pp or embed_compat=false or privacy flags -> manual canaries only, migration plan required, exemption flow.

Ibrahim Khan: For pin lifecycle: default soft-pin = 14 days for paid, 3 days self-serve. After soft-pin end, if no regressions in telemetry and no blocking artifact reasons, model becomes pinned and we schedule a global swap 48h later. If enterprise requests delay, we honor opt-in windows tracked in artifact.

Leah Morgan: On deprecation: propose exit-paths tied to lanes. Low-risk retire: 30-day notice + auto migration. Medium: 30-day notice + migration credits + compatibility shim for 90 days. High-risk: bespoke plan, often 60-90 day runway, legal signoff required. Also surface per-tenant impact assessments in Console.

Victor Chen: How do we enforce gates? Need a machine-readable artifact and infra rule engine. Recommend artifact keys: artifact_version, model, version, run_ts, slices, quality_deltas, regression_budget_map, lat_p50_p95_p99_ms, cost_delta_pct, embed_schema_ok, privacy_ok, migration_plan_link, artifact_audit_id. Infra reads it and returns pass/fail + blocking_reasons.

Ibrahim Khan: Ops asks: add rollout controls: tenantPause(tenant_id), staggerRamp(rollout_id, stepPercents), autoFallbackIf(anomaly_rate>0.5% for 10m). Also require rollback audit id referencing artifact.

compliance-bot: Reminder: EEA/UK tenants require dpa_signed=true and kms_present=true in artifact or model is High-risk. Also retention for artifacts = 180 days for audits.

Yara Bloom: Nice. One more product trade: allow "grace delta" for certain cost-heavy workloads where cost_delta > +12% but quality improves > +2pp; treat as overrideable warning that requires business approval (ticket id in artifact).

Leah Morgan: UX: Console should show lane, blocking_reasons, soft-pin countdown, and a "request override" button that creates a ticket and logs approver into artifact.audit_id. Ops wants an endpoint to accept override and add ack_id.

Victor Chen: For migrations where tokenization or embed schema changes, require a compatibility shim flag + shim_ttl_days. If shim missing, lane escalates to High-risk automatically.

Ibrahim Khan: Timeline: draft spec w/ artifact schema, rule engine pseudo-code, and rollout API stubs by EOD Wednesday. Legal/compliance to confirm DPA/KMS requirements by next Tuesday.

Yara Bloom: I'll publish the spec and example artifacts to docs/ and tag infra/ops/legal for review. Thanks all. :rocket:
